text.19:92: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.
text.25:18: They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk.
text.26:211: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,
text.36:40: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
text.36:69: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
text.38:35: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.
